huddle.opening: Can the confirmation response include the clinic's display name and address so I don't need a second call?

answers.say: Send UTC plus the clinic's IANA time zone; I convert on display. We got burned showing raw UTC to the Sydney clinic.

huddle.outcome: POST /bookings returns {id, start, end, tz, clinic: {name, address}, cancelUrl}.

lessons: Clinics care about local times; the Sydney clinic complained about UTC in v0.
